preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 400,000.
There are exactly n-1 edges in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two valid vertices.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in {0, 1} for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is either 0 or 1.
The i-th integer is 1 if the i-th vertex can be made a centroid by replacing no more than one edge, otherwise 0.
